Coaching
We are now offering private online one-on-one acting coaching!
(Get in touch for timing and prices).
Whether you are a seasoned actor looking to polish up your craft or you just embarked on your acting journey, coaching is crucial to give you the tools that you need.
Acting is not easy. It is not something immediate that comes naturally to everyone. One must be dedicated and committed to embark on the journey with an open heart – and a great coach too!
After all, let’s not forget how competitive the acting industry is, no matter where you are.
How can private coaching help you?
Self-taping is now a thing, and as you master the art of auditioning on video, you’ll inevitably train for this during your private sessions.
Look no further, book a session with us!
What to do?
Book your session
You’ll receive a confirmation e-mail
Reply to the email with your:
Acting resume
Headshots
Anything you wish to focus on during the session (we provide scripts for you)
We’ll be in touch about timing and links (coaching sessions available on Zoom/Facetime/Skype)

Consider starting with one session and see if it works out for you.
About the coach:
A theatre actress, director and producer, Nicole Garbellini has been in the theatre world for over 20 years.
She was recently seen in Mussolini’s Mistresses, as well as Silent Sky, The Complete Works of William Shakespeare-Abridged (Aurora Theatre), and Love Pings (I AM).
Her directing credits include, among others, The 39 Steps, Inherit The Wind, The Crucible, Dial “M” For Murder and Love Pings. Originally from Italy, she has worked and performed as an artist in her native country, as well as Australia, Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore.
You want to be a better actor? Better Call Nicole!
REVIEWS
“A great way to brush up on your acting skills or even jumping into acting for the first time. This crew of lovely and friendly people welcomes anyone who wants to do some acting. We laugh, we play, we perform scenes, we do improve and have a good time. I’ve been enjoying myself a lot with the team and want to keep going.”
Emilie B.
“I’ve been taking acting classes with Aurora for a year or so now, and have learned almost everything I know from there. The classes are a great mix of vocal and body warm-up exercises, improv (my personal favorite), and script work. I had acted before taking classes with Nicole, but only after these classes could I start to say that I was an actor. Highly recommended.”
Ryan K.
“By taking
Aurora Theatre Hong Kong
acting classes, I am learning a lot about what it takes to be an actor like exploring the scenes, going over character motivations and objectives, and evoking the emotion and tone of the scenes we were given. My stage presence has improved as well. I also really enjoy doing improv activities, meeting some new people. I look forward to it every week!! Plus, Nicole is such an awesome teacher! Overall, I highly recommend you take this class, it’s such a blast!”
Aaron M.
“Awesome theatre group with a strong sense of community. It’s a great intro to drama although the classes also include working actors, so it’s for everyone regardless of experience level. Nicole is our fearless leader – she’s very accommodating and genuinely cares. Couldn’t recommend it highly enough. ”
Carlo G.
“I’ve been taking Aurora’s acting classes with Nicole since January 2020. I just wanted to reconnect with the arts, I had never acted before, and as a non-native English speaker I was a bit scared I’d never be able to keep up with the rest of the group. But Nicole helped me build up my confidence, and taught me everything there’s to know about acting: improv, technicality (voice, stage presence, etc), storytelling and script work (plays, monologues, etc). She is always positive, gives constructive feedback to everyone and encourages us to be creative and make our own choices. We always have a great time.
Thank you, Nicole, and Aurora for bringing this community of very talented and creative people together – I look forward to our classes every week!”
Audrey G.
